suggested_requirements.text: The tool shall input sensed data in real time from data acquisition devices and the HVAC unit under diagnosis.
The tool shall permit sensed data to be input from an electronic file.
The tool shall input fixed data provided by the user.
The tool shall store sensed and fixed data to permanent storage.
The tool shall detect and identify performance and operational faults in chiller and cooling tower subsystems.
The tool shall store identified faults, causes, and sources to permanent storage.
The tool shall display diagnostic results in a graphical and textual format.
The tool shall print screen images of diagnostic results and historical data at user request.
The tool shall provide the capability to manually input and edit fixed data.
The tool shall provide the capability to adjust the sensitivity of the diagnostic algorithms.
The tool shall authenticate the user by checking an identifier and password against a database.
The tool shall automatically revert user privileges to general user after 15 minutes of inactivity.
The tool shall safeguard customer data.
The tool shall process sensed data in real time or batch mode.
The tool shall provide a visual indication of faults, descriptive information, and suggested corrective actions.
The tool shall support a wide variety of users with respect to computer expertise.
The tool shall be restricted to Microsoft Windows-compatible operating systems.
The tool shall support the incorporation of diagnostic algorithms for additional HVAC subsystems.
The tool shall provide long-term storage of diagnostic results and permit the user to supply metadata.
